body.title: git_text: the filters that read standard input
body.summary: Add git_text with column, stripspace, interpret-trailers, fmt-merge-msg, patch-id, mailinfo and mailsplit, each taking its content as an input and sending it through runShellBytes, with the input-budget refusal and the empty-content case. Mark the rows covered with cases; only this Task's own rows are checked.
acceptanceChecks: Each op receives the content given as its input and returns the command's answer
Empty content is delivered as empty input
Content over the input budget is refused before git starts
A failed delivery is a failure of the tool with no answer
